svg.text: Arduino UNO Q + MPXV7002DP pressure sensor + 10 kΩ / 10 kΩ voltage divider into pin A2
goes to A2 · about 1.25 V at rest
0.5 V to 4.5 V (too high for A2!)
Match pins by the LABEL on your
Multimeter (DC V) between row 15 and GND:
should read about 1.25 V. Never over 3.3 V.
3.3V and 5V sockets are side by side:
the sensor goes to 5V. Check the label.
Ignore the red + rails. They are unused.
